summary.text: Michelle Milne is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 49 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
She describes herself as an educator, theatre professional and coach with 30 years of facilitation experience.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Michelle Milne said she has 30 years of experience in facilitation, team-building and creative problem-solving as an educator and theatre professional, and works as a coach.
She said she has also worked in hospitality and retail, managed research projects and led workshops for professionals including lawyers, nurses and architects.
Milne said her campaign centers on listening to constituents and removing barriers for families, individuals and small businesses, with more local control over state mandates.
She listed public education, healthcare, local control, economic equity, safety and farmland protection as her policy priorities.
Endorsements she listed include IUOE Local 150, the Indiana Reproductive Freedom PAC and Indiana Young Democrats.
